_note: ENGIE Stadium plan, model metres: x east, y north, z up from the field; bearings clockwise from north, from the OSM AFL pitch's centre (lat -33.8431119, lon 151.0676851). fence, rf, rb: rings of one smooth curve fitted to a Google Earth top-down trace, each an exact offset of it (tools/grounds/engie/fit; 'outline' holds the curve). front_gap measured from Google Earth (field edge to the first seats). From OpenStreetMap (ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, osm.py): the light masts' bases, the video wall and the site outline. The towers' tops (46 m, leaning in) were triangulated from two Google Earth views each.

outline._note: The field edge: a 5-harmonic polar curve fitted to the turf edge in Google Earth top-down, sunlit (east, south) and traced in the shade (west, north; fieldshadow.py) (field). Between the roofs at the open north-east end (3 to 77 deg) rf and rb are a filler run with no roof over it. The 1998 bowl: one smooth curve (6-harmonic polar series about (cx, cy), t clockwise from north) fitted to its roof front; its roof back is an exact normal offset. The 2012 north and east stands: each roof edge a circular arc of its own, joined tangentially to the bowl ring at bj (degrees); the east roof front is two arcs, the second (corner) tangent to the first at bk. The stand front is the roof front ring 1.6 m in, everywhere. tools/grounds/engie/fit.
